introHtml: White mylar exit barrier bags offer a clean, professional look that stands out in security screening lines. The bright white material provides high contrast for printed logos, making your brand or event name highly visible. These bags are ideal for conferences, stadiums, and corporate events where a crisp, uniform appearance is desired. The durable mylar construction ensures contents stay secure while offering a premium feel that standard plastic bags cannot match.
